name: SDN Data Retrieval
description: Engine-native FlatSQL retrieval for the data-retrieval flow (typed contracts 1.0: SDS $QRP in and out, no JSON, no CAQ). Method "omm_bulk" (the per-standard bulk route, any SDS standard the store holds): an optional $QRP Request (SCHEMA_NAME, SOURCE_NAME, TIME_PROFILE, PROFILE_EPOCH_MS, LIMIT) resolved request > module config (plugin.getConfig entries "profiles.<SCHEMA>.profile|source|limit|epoch") > compiled fallback (nearest, 50000, epoch = clock.now) -> storage.flatsql_epoch_stream (SDS $PIV EpochStreamParams; TIME_PROFILE Unspecified = not stated -> config -> nearest; the engine profiles are nearest, as_of, forward; Latest is refused) or, for TIME_PROFILE All (every record in the window), storage.flatsql_query_stream over the standard's table filtered by the source shadow "<CODE>@<source>" and, for $OMM only, by FROM_EPOCH_MS / TO_EPOCH_MS on USER_DEFINED_EPOCH_TIMESTAMP (a window on another standard or with a per-object profile is refused 400 window-unsupported). Method "data_query": a $QRP Request carrying SQL and typed PARAMETERS -> storage.flatsql_query_stream (raw sql + list sql_params SqlValue; a Bytes parameter or text over 255 bytes is refused, never truncated). Both answer "decision" (the request, or a $QRP KIND Error) and "page" (a $QRP page stream: the KIND Page header then the host's record frames verbatim, with RECORD_COUNT and a W/"fnv1a64-..." ETAG over the records). Values over a hostcall bound are refused by name, never truncated. Every $QRP Error carries HTTP_STATUS; success pages carry 200. Delivery: a request whose REPRESENTATION is not Json asks the host for DELIVER Ref; a host answering a BodyRef keeps the bytes for the egress and the page is the header ALONE with BODY_REF_TOKEN / BODY_REF_SIZE, RECORD_COUNT = the host's frame count and ETAG W/"fnv1a64-<host hash>". A host that ignores Ref, and every Json request, gets the bytes inline. The former engine-linked (SDN_FLATSQL_LINKED) lane is retired.

externalInterfaces.description: Host FlatSQL engine-native retrieval ops as SDS $PIV hostcalls: storage.flatsql_epoch_stream (EpochStreamParams -> StreamResult + raw stream) and storage.flatsql_query_stream (SqlStreamParams + raw sql + list sql_params -> StreamResult + raw stream).
clock.now defaults omm_bulk's epoch when neither the request nor the config states one; plugin.getConfig (ungated) supplies the per-standard profile defaults.

acceptedTypeSets.description: $QRP KIND Request: SCHEMA_NAME (standard code, default OMM), SOURCE_NAME, TIME_PROFILE (Unspecified = not stated; All = every record in the FROM_EPOCH_MS / TO_EPOCH_MS window), PROFILE_EPOCH_MS (0 = config or now), LIMIT (0 = config or 50000), REPRESENTATION, ETAG (If-None-Match). A KIND Error arriving here is passed on untouched.

inputPorts.description: Optional $QRP Request from foundation/http-route (the "/<code>/bulk" route). Without one, the config / compiled defaults apply.

acceptedTypeSets.description: $QRP KIND Request (served) or KIND Error. Error codes (HTTP_STATUS set): invalid-profile / invalid-parameter / window-unsupported / missing-sql / unsupported-parameter / query-failed (400), host-failed (502), unavailable (503).

outputPorts.description: Exactly one $QRP per invoke: the request on success (omm_bulk without a request frame: the default Request it resolved), or a KIND Error (ERROR_CODE/MESSAGE, the request's REPRESENTATION and ETAG carried) when the request is refused or the host fails.

acceptedTypeSets.description: $QRP page stream: [u32 len][size-prefixed $QRP KIND Page header] (+ a zero u32 padding prefix when the header is not 8-byte aligned), then the host's size-prefixed record frames VERBATIM. Header: SCHEMA_NAME (standard code), FILE_IDENTIFIER (first record frame), RECORD_COUNT (frames that follow), ETAG W/"fnv1a64-<16 hex>" over the record stream bytes, REPRESENTATION and the resolved request echoed. With a host body reference (DELIVER Ref) the page is the header alone carrying BODY_REF_TOKEN / BODY_REF_SIZE; HTTP_STATUS 200.

outputPorts.description: Present only when the request was served: one $QRP page stream.

methods.description: Resolves the per-standard epoch query profile (request > config > defaults), streams the matching records from storage.flatsql_epoch_stream, and answers the request on "decision" plus a $QRP page stream on "page". BATCHING: every input port is single-stream BY CONTRACT and ENFORCED IN CODE: the compiled flow runtime drains a node's queue port-blind (maxStreams/maxBatch are declarative only), so a surplus frame is refused with error code "batched-input-frames" naming the port and the count rather than silently discarded (graph task modules-guest-nodes-drop-batched-frames).

acceptedTypeSets.description: $QRP KIND Request: SQL (required), PARAMETERS (QRPValue Null/Bool/Int/Float/Text; Bytes and text over 255 bytes are refused), REPRESENTATION, ETAG. A KIND Error arriving here is passed on untouched.

$QRP KIND Request (served) or KIND Error. Error codes (HTTP_STATUS set): invalid-profile / invalid-parameter / window-unsupported / missing-sql / unsupported-parameter / query-failed (400), host-failed (502), unavailable (503).

outputPorts.description: Exactly one $QRP per invoke: the request on success (omm_bulk without a request frame: the default Request it resolved), or a KIND Error (ERROR_CODE/MESSAGE, the request's REPRESENTATION and ETAG carried) when the request is refused or the host fails.

acceptedTypeSets.description: $QRP page stream: [u32 len][size-prefixed $QRP KIND Page header] (+ a zero u32 padding prefix when the header is not 8-byte aligned), then the host's size-prefixed record frames VERBATIM. Header: SCHEMA_NAME (standard code), FILE_IDENTIFIER (first record frame), RECORD_COUNT (frames that follow), ETAG W/"fnv1a64-<16 hex>" over the record stream bytes, REPRESENTATION and the resolved request echoed. With a host body reference (DELIVER Ref) the page is the header alone carrying BODY_REF_TOKEN / BODY_REF_SIZE; HTTP_STATUS 200.

outputPorts.description: Present only when the request was served: one $QRP page stream.

methods.description: Executes the request's SQL with its typed parameters through storage.flatsql_query_stream and answers the request on "decision" plus a $QRP page stream on "page" (SCHEMA_NAME / FILE_IDENTIFIER from the first record frame). BATCHING: every input port is single-stream BY CONTRACT and ENFORCED IN CODE: the compiled flow runtime drains a node's queue port-blind (maxStreams/maxBatch are declarative only), so a surplus frame is refused with error code "batched-input-frames" naming the port and the count rather than silently discarded (graph task modules-guest-nodes-drop-batched-frames).
